summary.name: invideo
summary.one_liner: invideo is an online AI video creation and editing tool, with an editor, AI agents, and credit-based plans.
use_cases: Generating short videos with AI from prompts
Editing AI-generated video in a browser timeline
Collaborating with others on a video project
Adding stock footage and audio to videos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes invideo as an online editor for creating and editing AI videos, using an AI agent called Agent Two. It includes a timeline editor and professional tools for color, audio, and 3D. Multiplayer editing is offered with a seat limit. Usage is measured in credits per seat per month, and different AI models (such as Seedance 2.0 variants and Nano Banana Pro) are available depending on the plan. The Basic plan shown lists 190 credits per seat per month, 45 premium stock footage clips, and 100 GB of storage.
notable: Agent Two AI agent for video creation and editing
Multiplayer editing with up to 5 seats on Basic
Timeline editor with color, audio, and 3D tools
Credit-based access to models such as Seedance 2.0 and Nano Banana Pro
caveats: Advanced models and features depend on the selected plan; Basic has no access to Seedance 2.5 or Seedance 2.0 and only Agent Two Lite
Basic plan's 50% first-time discount is aimed at first-time AI creators
Basic plan has no guest seats and no early access to advanced AI features
